mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eco_point_history (member_id, point_amount, balance_after, point_type, reference_type, reference_id) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{pointAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{pointType}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT balance_after FROM eco_point_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY eco_point_history_id DESC LIMIT 1 ),0)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(point_amount),0) FROM eco_point_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND point_type = 'EARN'

SELECT eco_point_history_id AS ecoPointHistoryId, member_id AS memberId, point_amount AS pointAmount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, point_type AS pointType, reference_type AS referenceType, reference_id AS referenceId, created_at AS createdAt
FROM eco_point_history WHERE member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY eco_point_history_id desc
